```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# 1. Read the data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat('<table class="table" style="width:100%;">')
cat('<thead>
      <tr>
        <th>Screenshot</th>
        <th>Repo Name</th>
        <th>Project Title</th>
        <th>Last Updated</th>
      </tr>
    </thead><tbody>')

for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  # Clean up strings
  repo_full <- trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i])
  repo_name <- gsub("aakritixyz/", "", repo_full)
  
  # Construct URLs - Using timestamp to force-refresh images
  timestamp <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  public_url <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", repo_name, "/")
  img_url <- paste0(public_url, "Capture.PNG?v=", timestamp)
  
  cat('<tr>')
  
  # Column 1: Screenshot (Linked to Demo)
  cat('<td>')
  cat(paste0('<a href="', public_url, '">'))
  cat(paste0('<img src="', img_url, '" width="300" style="border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:4px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);">'))
  cat('</a></td>')
  
  # Column 2: Repo Name (Monospace font for code feel)
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle; font-family: monospace;">')
  cat(paste0('<a href="', public_url, '">', repo_name, '.viz</a>'))
  cat('</td>')
  
  # Column 3: Project Title
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle;">')
  cat(paste0('<b>', trimws(dt$title[i]), '</b>'))
  cat('</td>')
  
  # Column 4: Timestamp (Mirroring the ISO format in your screenshot)
  cat('<td style="vertical-align: middle; color: #666; font-size: 0.85em;">')
  cat(paste0(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")))
  cat('</td>')
  
  cat('</tr>')
}

cat('</tbody></table>')

cat('<br><hr>')
cat('<h3>Source Code</h3>')
cat('<ul><li><a href="[https://github.com/aakritixyz/animint-gallery](https://github.com/aakritixyz/animint-gallery)">Repository of this gallery</a></li></ul>')
